description: Defines the PolicyEntry interface for representing a single policy entry with label, subjects, and resources, including JSON serialization details and factory method.

classes.name: PolicyEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a policy entry with label, subjects, resources, supporting JSON serialization and versioning.

classes.name: PolicyEntry.JsonFields
classes.description: Contains definitions of JSON fields used in PolicyEntry, including schema version, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry with specified label, subjects, and resources via factory.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns supported JSON schema versions for PolicyEntry, specifically version 2.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Retrieves the subjects associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Retrieves the resources associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to JSON including only non-hidden fields.

methods.name: toJson (overloaded)
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to JSON with specified schema version and field selector.
